note: This is an ICE-style layout printed as stacked labelled lines rather than a ruled grid, so there is no distinct header row (header left empty). Row 1 is the equilibrium equation itself (printed above the labelled lines); row 2 'Initial concentration (M)' is a label line followed by its three values (c, 0, 0) for HX, H3O+ and X- respectively (H2O's concentration is omitted, consistent with it being a pure liquid, as in the preceding page's K_w derivation); 'Let α be the extent of ionization' is a sentence printed between the Initial and Change blocks, kept as its own row to preserve exact line order; 'Change (M)' labels the final value row (-cα, +cα, +cα). The crop (and target_box_in_crop) ends right after this last value row; the following 'Equilibrium concentration (M)' label and its value row (c-cα, cα, cα), visible lower in the full page image, fall outside target_box_in_crop and belong to a different block, so they are excluded here.
